description: This Java class 'ShoppingCartHelper' provides utility methods for managing shopping cart operations such as adding, modifying, deleting items, handling requirements, and applying agreements within an e-commerce system. It acts as a facade over the core ShoppingCart object, simplifying interactions with the cart and integrating with other system components like product features, promotions, and order agreements.

classes.name: ShoppingCartHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing simplified methods to manipulate shopping cart items, handle requirements, apply agreements, and manage cart state within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart with detailed parameters including product info, reservation dates, configuration, and context.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items to the cart based on existing order items, with options to add all or specific items.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds multiple products in bulk based on context parameters, typically from form inputs.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds requirement items in bulk, possibly per row in a multi-form submission.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds default products from a specified category to the cart.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes specified items from the cart based on context keys.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Updates quantities, descriptions, comments, and other attributes of cart items; handles deletions and applies promotions.

methods.name: getFeatureAppl
methods.description: Retrieves a product feature application value based on product ID, option field, and feature ID.

methods.name: getRemoveFeatureTypeId
methods.description: Extracts the feature type ID from an option field string.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates an agreement with the cart, setting currency and order terms based on the agreement.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the cart.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Adds an order term to the cart, with optional text value.

methods.name: removeOrderTerm
methods.description: Removes an order term from the cart by index.
